title: Your body is not a project to fix (mirror reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
Your body is not a project to fix. 🪞

It's the home that carries you through every single day.
Most of the notes on your mirror were written by someone else.
Next time you catch one, peel it off and say one kind thing instead.

Send this to someone who's hard on her reflection.

#bodyacceptance #selflove #selfacceptance #emotionalwellness #soundmind
